title.narrative: Materials programme 2021-2025

description.narrative: The materials program delivers a package of interventions across the farm-to-consumer lifecycle, working with our partners to continuously deliver better incomes for smallholder farmers and a better environment, driving sustainable sourcing at scale, and reducing negative environmental impacts of key apparel and textiles materials. By concentrating on key material categories such as cotton and polyester, IDH focus on interventions in these three Programs: Better Cotton strategic partnership; Climate-smart Cotton Landscapes (CCL); and Alternate Materials.
